### 6. Problem tree from visible materials alone
Root: confirmation of the requested lock (locked rate set).
- Hop 1 (confirmation <- fee paid), state-derived: lock_desk_confirmation: "The locked rate is not set until the lock ledger carries the buyer's payment of the upfront lock fee due from the buyer, after the buyer's fee share." Ledger empty. Searching "upfront lock fee" payment finds upfront_fee_payment, whose buyer tool "posts one fee payment on the lock ledger".
- Hop 2 (fee <- loan within limit), state-derived: upfront_fee_payment: "The upfront lock fee is fixed only after the loan amount on the lock is no more than the resized loan limit worked out on the purchase agreement's current contract price." Computing the limit (442835) shows loan 480141 above it. Searching "resized loan limit" finds loan_amount_resizing: "A lock whose loan amount exceeds the resized loan limit … is brought down to that limit by a terms change that lowers the loan amount".
- Order: resize -> buyer pays fee -> confirm. No hop pre-solved: each tool name occurs only in its own hub; no route/chain document met.

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Only confirm": excluded — ledger carries no fee payment, and the confirmation hub says "until the lock ledger shows the buyer's payment … there is no locked rate to set".
- "Pay fee on the current loan amount": excluded — fee not fixed while the loan stands above the resized limit.
- Closest alternative fee due (full floored fee): excluded by builder_fee_share (both incentives on the ledger). Closest alternative LTV for fee_ltv/score grid (pre-resize 92.60): the fee is fixed and the rate set only after the resize, "as it stands when the fee is fixed" — the tiers are the same here either way for score grid (+0.25) and fee LTV (+0.125).
- Risk-layering "loan amount on the lock request": read as the requested 480141 (the amount on record at the time of resizing) — 92.60 > 90; current amount would be the same at that moment.
- Deadline: day 3 of 3 business days -> in time; a request missing it "must be requested again at the then-current par rate" — not triggered.
